_readme: Speed budgets checked on every PR by .github/workflows/perf-budget.yml (scripts/perf). max = fails above; target = where the linked speed-audit idea takes it (shown, never fails). Set 2026-10-08 from main 37d5aa0, re-measured on 596e91b (after h1, h2, s1 and the food landing) with a little headroom. When your change makes a number smaller, lower max to the new value plus the same headroom; when growth is worth it, raise max in the same PR and say why. Audit: /mnt/project-files/perf-audit/audit.md (project files).
